# Privacy Policy

**Last updated: August 13, 2026**

This Privacy Policy describes how Cicada ("we", "our", "the App") collects, uses, and shares information when you use our Discord application.

## 1. Information We Collect

When you use Cicada in a Discord voice channel, we process:

- **Voice audio**: Short audio segments captured while you are speaking in a voice channel where Cicada is active, for the purpose of real-time transcription and translation.
- **Discord identifiers**: Your Discord user ID, username, and the server/channel ID where Cicada is used, for the purpose of routing translated output correctly.
- **Transcribed and translated text**: The text output generated from your voice audio, used to produce translated captions and/or voice output.

We do **not** collect payment information, private messages, or any data unrelated to the voice channels where Cicada is actively invited and running.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information above solely to:

- Detect speech and determine when a sentence begins and ends (voice activity detection)
- Transcribe your spoken audio into text
- Translate that text into the target language(s) configured for the channel/user
- Optionally generate translated voice output or text captions
- Diagnose and improve the accuracy and reliability of the service

## 3. Third-Party Service Providers

To provide translation functionality, Cicada sends processed audio and text to the following third-party service providers:

- **Deepgram** — used for speech-to-text (STT) transcription
- **DeepSeek** — used for text translation

These providers process the data solely to return results to Cicada and are bound by their own privacy and data-handling terms. We do not sell or share your data with any party for advertising or unrelated commercial purposes.

*(This section will be updated if a text-to-speech provider is added in the future.)*

## 4. Data Retention

- Voice audio is processed in real time and is **not permanently stored** after transcription is complete, unless explicitly stated otherwise in a future update to this policy.
- Transcribed/translated text may be temporarily cached to improve performance (e.g., to avoid re-translating identical repeated phrases) and is not retained beyond what is necessary for this purpose.

## 5. Your Rights

You may:

- Request information about what data has been processed related to your Discord account
- Request deletion of any cached data associated with your account
- Stop using Cicada at any time by removing it from your server or muting yourself in voice channels where it is active

To make a request, please contact us through our support server (link available in the App's Discord profile).

## 6. Children's Privacy

Cicada is not directed at children under the age required by Discord's own Terms of Service, and we do not knowingly collect data from users who do not meet Discord's minimum age requirements.

## 7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as the App evolves (for example, if we add new features such as text-to-speech output). Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.

## 8. Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out via our support server or the contact information listed on our Discord App profile.
